Elon Musk says humanity doesn't even register on the scale aliens would use to judge us..

in 1964 a Soviet astronomer named Nikolai Kardashev ranked civilizations by power..

Type 1..
use all the energy of your planet..

Type 2..
use all the energy of your star..

Type 3..
use all the energy of your galaxy..

where are we..

not even Type 1..

the sun holds 99.86% of all the mass in our solar system..

Earth is in the tiny miscellaneous part..

and humanity uses less than a trillionth of the sun's power..

Musk says reaching one millionth would be an epic achievement..

we think we're advanced..

on a cosmic scale..

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Tesla now runs half of America’s public DC fast chargers with over 40,000 ports, while the $7.5B federal NEVI program had opened just 384 by April 2025.

One company built the backbone of the national network with its own capital while the government spent billions and produced a rounding error. 

Private industry is still outpacing the mandate, and that gap isn’t narrowing anytime soon.

posts.text:
My @grok @bot monitors my calendar, and when it sees my return flight has landed, it turns on my @tesla so the temperature is just right when I get to the parking lot. 

Then I summon the vehicle and it comes to me on its own. Feels like living in the future…

quote.author: davidsven
quote.name: David Woodland
quote.text:
Today I learned if you create a Tesla Developer account, they give you $10/month of free API calls. So, you can basically vibecode your own interface and/or just connect your car to an agent.

Super cool, cause now I just have agent handle things like "When I climb in bed, if my battery is under 30% and the truck isn't plugged in, notify me". 

Also now have a Mac client to control my car. Muse one-shot the app in the screenshot below.

API calls are like $0.002 each, so you can basically build anything you want and stay under a $10/month budget.

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Here is the @Tesla Roadster’s battery and drive unit, which is one-third more powerful than the Model S Plaid’s, with half the mass.

Tesla: “The new high-voltage battery and drive unit technology used to drive Roadster enables our most powerful and compact rear-wheel drive unit yet. Together, they deliver 1 MW of pure power-that's one third more power than Model S Plaid-with half the mass. The result is paradigm-shifting acceleration with amazing cornering and precise stopping power.”
